identity.addresses: Kinkerstraat 32-54 (even), Da Costakade 157-165 (odd), Da Costastraat 66-70 (even): 66 verblijfsobjecten, woon-, winkel-, bijeenkomst- and industriefunctie; the Vomar supermarket on the Kinkerstraat ground floor
identity.architect: not named by nl.wikipedia (articles Kinkerstraat, Kinkerbuurt), the BAG or the monument registers (no monument record); unconfirmed
identity.correctionsToBrief: The block is not at the De Hallen end: it stands at the east end of the Kinkerstraat between the Da Costakade and the Da Costastraat (De Hallen is about 350 m west). One BAG pand covers three volumes: light grey-beige brick corner blocks at both Kinkerstraat corners and the red-brick bar and side wings; the red bar has three brick storeys over a glazed shop ground and a glazed mezzanine of loggias, and the top is a zinc mansard with dormers (not a set-back top floor); only the west corner block has a set-back top storey.
